title: October PCE inflation 3.8%, core 3.3% three-year high; December rate hike probability ~97%
summary: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, the PCE price index, rose 3.8% year-over-year in October, with core PCE at 3.3%—a three-year high. CME FedWatch data showed the market pricing in approximately 97% probability of a 25bp rate hike at the December FOMC meeting. Strong GDP growth and elevated inflation reinforce expectations that the Fed will act in December.
why: 通胀持续高于预期，市场对美联储12月加息几成定局（CME FedWatch概率约97%，来源：本轮检索到的capitaldigest.com报道引用CME数据）。高利率环境对科技、成长股估值形成压制；对以 sell put 为主的期权策略，行权区间设定需考虑波动率可能随加息预期变化而上升。

title: Asia-Pacific markets rebound Nov 26; Hang Seng +1.9%, Hang Seng Tech +2.6%, tech leads recovery
summary: Asia-Pacific equity markets rose broadly on November 26, with the Hang Seng Index gaining approximately 1.9% in morning trading and the Hang Seng Tech Index climbing approximately 2.6%. South Korea's Kospi led regional gains. Markets tracked an overnight Wall Street recovery, with tech and AI stocks rebounding following the prior session's sell-off driven by tariff concerns and hot inflation data. Li Auto's strong Q3 earnings provided additional support to Hong Kong-listed EV and AI stocks. 当日大盘头条确认4条，白名单核实源不足5条，当日确实偏少。
why: 港股科技板块单日大幅反弹，AI与EV龙头领涨，短线情绪回暖；sell put 策略需关注恒生科技隐含波动率变化，大幅波动前后 IV crush 和 spike 均可能出现。

title: Li Auto Q3 2026: Beats Revenue Guidance, Net Loss Narrows 50%, FCF Turns Positive, Q4 Profitability Guided
summary: Li Auto reported Q3 2026 revenue of RMB 28.8bn, above its guidance range of RMB 26.6–28.0bn. Net loss narrowed 50.4% year-over-year to RMB 310M. Free cash flow turned positive at RMB 2.0bn. Vehicle deliveries totaled 110,183 units. Q4 2026 guidance: 110,000–115,000 deliveries, with management targeting a return to profitability. Li Auto shares surged approximately 11.3% in Hong Kong trading on November 25.
why: 理想汽车利润率回升（毛利率16.7%）、FCF转正是高质量复苏信号；作为EV+大模型相关核心标的，业绩改善对港股EV板块情绪有提振作用；业绩超预期后 IV 收缩，可关注 sell put 时机。

title: 沪深北三交易所：融资买入最低保证金比例下调至80%，11月30日起施行
summary: 沪深北三家交易所11月22日发布通知，将投资者融资买入证券的最低保证金比例由100%下调至80%，自2026年11月30日起施行。据券商测算，此举预计向市场释放约4000亿元增量资金，提升A股市场整体资金杠杆水平。A股主要指数11月26日开盘高开，市场响应政策预期。
why: 延续报道：政策11月22日由三交易所公告，11月30日正式施行，当前仍在发酵。融资杠杆扩容改善A股资金面，蓝筹与科技板块预计受益；杠杆扩张同时意味着市场波动率可能上升，对期权定价和 sell put 风险管理均有影响。

title: 腾讯大股东Prosus CEO：AI将产生重大影响，对腾讯极为看好，不会再减持腾讯
summary: Prosus首席执行官Fabricio Bloisi在业绩发布会上表示，AI将对行业产生重大影响，对腾讯（0700.HK）极为看好，认为腾讯有望在AI竞争中脱颖而出，相比美国科技股其估值仍有提升空间。Bloisi还表示，Prosus将通过出售其他资产进行股份回购，尽量避免进一步减持腾讯股份。
why: 大股东公开表态不减持并背书腾讯AI前景，短期可能提振市场情绪；Prosus减持压力减轻对腾讯股价支撑有正面意义，持有腾讯期权仓位者可关注隐含波动率变化。

title: Laopu Gold (6181.HK) falls ~3% on gold price weakness; down ~56% year-to-date
summary: Laopu Gold (6181.HK) dropped approximately 3% in recent trading, weighed down by weakness in gold prices. The stock has fallen approximately 56% year-to-date. The company's zero-hedging policy means its performance is closely tied to gold price movements, amplifying both upside and downside versus hedged peers. JPMorgan maintained a Buy rating with a HKD 400 target price, noting no second price increase was planned in the near term.
why: 老铺黄金零对冲策略放大金价波动对股价的影响；金价若持续低迷，sell put风险较大；若金价触底反弹，标的弹性也较大，波动率策略需密切跟踪黄金走势。
